blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
blocks.zh: 视底基准通常不考虑现实世界情景的背景不确定性。 在这项研究中,我们构建了一个新的基准,即日本对“与对话相伴”的视觉定位数据集的评估。 它包括人-机器人对话的多模式互动,涵盖视觉和语言类别产生的不同类型的模糊。 我们评价不同最先进的视觉语言模型(VLMs)识别和解析的能力. 我们比较了作为视觉和语言模糊性分辨率基础的对话背景。 我们的实验表明,VLMs可以通过使用对话上下文来大幅度地改善语言模糊度的解析,特别是日本的零角草. 我们进一步进行了比较分析,以了解对话的语义内容或对话结构是否带来根本性的改进。

blocks.en: Visual grounding is the task of localizing visual regions described by referring expressions in natural language, and has achieved substantial progress on standard benchmarks ( Plummer et al., 2017 ; Rohrbach et al., 2016 ) . However, these benchmarks evaluate models under idealized conditions where referring expressions are unambiguous, single-target, and context-independent ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , even if such assumptions are not valid for real-world settings. This limitation motivates the need to address ambiguity in referring expressions in realistic scenarios such as human-robot interaction.
blocks.zh: 视觉地基是自然语言引用表达方式描述的视觉区域本地化的任务,并在标准基准上取得了实质性进展(Plummer等,2017;Rohrbach等,2016.). 然而,这些基准在理想化的条件下对模型进行评价,在这种条件下,引用的表达方式是毫不含糊的、单一的、独立的(Xiao等人,2026年),即使这些假设对现实世界环境无效。 这种限制促使人们需要解决在人与机器人互动等现实情景中提及表达方式时的模糊性。

blocks.en: Ambiguity resolution in language has been widely studied, particularly at the lexical and sentential levels ( Gonzalo et al., 1999 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Schouten et al., 2023 ; Karamolegkou et al., 2025 ) . Multimodal ambiguity resolution is equally important, and tasks such as visual question answering have attracted particular attention ( Stengel-Eskin et al., 2023 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . However, such tasks capture only part of the referential communication required in human-robot interaction. To achieve appropriate interaction grounded to the world, computational systems must be able to properly interpret references that depend more heavily on the situational context. In real-world scenarios, user utterances contain diverse forms of instructions and omissions, and resolving them requires the use of various types of information, such as dialogue history DeVault and Stone (2009) , pointing Constantin et al. (2023) , and gaze Inadumi et al. (2024) . In particular, appropriately interpreting context by combining dialogue with visual input is one of the capabilities required of dialogue agents ( Das et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: 语言上的模糊性解析度得到了广泛的研究,特别是在词汇和传记层面(Gonzalo等,1999年;Liu等,2023年;Schouten等,2023年;Karamolegkou等,2025年)。 多式联运模糊性解析也同样重要,视觉问答等任务引起了特别关注(Stengel-Eskin等,2023;Nam等,2025;周等,2025.). 然而,这些任务只掌握了人类-机器人互动中所需的部分优惠通信。 为了实现基于世界的适当互动,计算系统必须能够正确解释更依赖于情况背景的参考文献。 在现实世界的情景中,用户的言词包含多种形式的指令和遗漏,解决这些问题需要使用各类信息,如对话史德沃特和斯通(2009年),指向君士坦丁等 (2023年),以及凝视伊纳杜米等 (2024年). 特别是,通过将对话与视觉投入结合起来来适当解释背景是对话代理人所需要的能力之一(Das等人,2017年)。

blocks.en: For example, consider the situation shown in Figure 1 , where two mugs are placed side by side on a table in a living room and a human instructs a robot to “take that mug.” To resolve this ambiguity, it is necessary to use the dialogue context that indicates what “that” refers to. In this case, the ambiguity to be resolved through the dialogue context exists in both the visual and linguistic modalities. Visual ambiguity can arise when multiple similar objects are present in the visual scene, or when multiple objects share the same attributes ( Zhang et al., 2018 ; Zeng et al., 2024 ) . Linguistic ambiguity ( Berzak et al., 2015 ) , on the other hand, prominently involves demonstratives, overt pronouns, and zero pronouns (zero anaphora). Zero anaphora is a linguistic phenomenon in which a referring expression, such as a subject or object, is omitted but recoverable from context. It is particularly prevalent in pro-drop languages such as Japanese Seki et al. (2002) , Chinese Kong and Zhou (2010) , and Korean Park et al. (2015) . In this work, we especially focus on phenomena in Japanese.

Zero anaphora是一种语言现象,在这种现象中,一个被引用的表达方式,如一个主题或对象被省略,但可以从上下文中恢复. 它在日语Seki等语言中尤其盛行(2002年),中刚和周通(2010年),韩朴等(2015年). 在这部作品中,我们特别关注日文中的现象.

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks do not jointly control the source of ambiguity and the context used to resolve it, making it impossible to determine whether grounding failures arise from perceptual or discourse-level limitations. To clarify the extent to which multimodal systems can address these problems, and where their limitations lie, we introduce Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D). JAG-D contains 480 carefully curated instances, each combining an image, an instruction, and a dialogue history. We prioritize annotation quality over benchmark scale, limiting the dataset size so that human experts, with more than eight years of experience in discourse structure annotation, can thoroughly verify each instance. The utterances in JAG-D contain diverse ambiguities arising from both visual and linguistic factors, and the dataset consists of situations in which these ambiguities are expected to be resolved by referring to the dialogue history.
blocks.zh: 现有的基准不能共同控制模糊性的来源和用来解决模糊性的背景,因此无法确定以概念或话语层面的限制为理由的失败。 为了澄清多式联运系统能够在多大程度上解决这些问题,以及其局限性所在,我们介绍日本对“用对话进行模糊视觉定位”的评价。 JAG-D包含480个精心整理的例,每个例都结合了一幅图像,一幅指示和一幅对话历史. 我们把注释质量置于基准范围之上,限制数据集的大小,以便拥有八年以上讨论结构注释经验的人类专家能够彻底核实每个实例。 联合咨询组-D的言论包含各种由视觉和语言因素造成的模糊不清之处,数据集包含一些情况,预计通过提及对话历史来解决这些模糊不清之处。

blocks.en: Using this benchmark, we discuss the ambiguity recognition and ambiguity resolution capabilities of visual grounding systems, including current VLMs. First, we evaluate the ability to determine whether a given pair of current instruction and image situation contains ambiguity. Second, we discuss ambiguity resolution ability when dialogue context is provided, namely the improvement in grounding accuracy. As evaluation targets, we use representative visual grounding models including GLIP Li et al. (2022) and MDETR Kamath et al. (2021) , as well as Qwen3-VL Bai et al. (2025) , a general-purpose VLM with visual grounding capabilities.
blocks.zh: 使用这个基准,我们讨论视觉地基系统,包括目前的VLM的模糊识别和模糊分辨率能力. 首先,我们评价确定一对当前指令和图像情况是否包含模糊性的能力。 第二,我们讨论在提供对话背景时的模糊性解决能力,即提高基础准确性。 作为评价目标,我们使用具有代表性的视觉地基模型,包括GLIP Li等 (2022)和MDETR Kamath等 (2021),以及Qune3-VL Bai等 (2025),一种具有视觉地基能力的通用VLM.

blocks.en: Our experiments reveal that current models can robustly recognize linguistically ambiguous scenarios; however, fail when the ambiguity arises from the visual scene. We also find that using additional dialogue context substantially resolves linguistic ambiguity, especially ambiguity caused by zero anaphora, whereas its contribution to resolving visual ambiguity is limited. This asymmetry suggests that current multimodal models rely heavily on linguistic surface cues rather than actively reasoning about the structure of the visual scene. Closing this gap will require models that treat perception and discourse as jointly informative sources ( Inadumi et al., 2025 ) , rather than treating dialogue as a post-hoc filter over linguistically driven predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,目前的模型能够强烈地识别语言上的模棱两可的情况;然而,当视觉场景产生模棱两可时,则失败了。 我们还发现,利用额外的对话背景,大大地解决了语言上的模糊性,特别是由零相声造成的模糊性,而它对解决视觉上的模糊性的贡献是有限的。 这种不对称现象表明,目前的多模式模型严重依赖语言表面提示,而不是对视觉场景结构的积极推理. 缩小这一差距需要将感知和言论视为共同信息来源的模型(Inadumi等,2025年),而不是将对话视为对语言驱动的预测进行事后过滤。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: 1. We introduce JAG-D, a Japanese benchmark for studying ambiguity resolution in human-robot visual grounding. JAG-D provides controlled coverage of diverse linguistic and visual ambiguities, as well as dialogue history used as disambiguation context. 2. We provide a systematic evaluation of ambiguity recognition and ambiguous visual grounding. Our results show that visual ambiguity remains a systematic blind spot for both monolingual Japanese and multilingual VLMs. 3. We show that dialogue history improves visual grounding by resolving ambiguities that cannot be addressed from a single instruction alone. We further introduce a dialogue intervention analysis to quantify how different dialogue aspects affect grounding accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下: 1. 我们采用JAG-D,这是日本研究人-机器人视觉地面模糊度的基准。 JAG-D提供了对各种语言和视觉模糊性以及用作混淆背景的对话历史的控制范围。 2. 我们系统地评估模糊性认识和模糊的视觉基础。 我们的结果显示,视觉模糊仍然是单一语言的日本语和多语言的VLM系统盲点。 3. 我们显示,对话历史通过解决单凭一项指示无法解决的模糊不清问题,改善了视觉基础。 我们还进行了对话干预分析,以量化不同对话方面如何影响定位准确性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual grounding is a fundamental task that links referring expressions to regions in the visual world. The literature includes foundational benchmarks like RefCOCO and its variations ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Kazemzadeh et al., 2014 ; Yu et al., 2016 ) , Flickr30k Entities ( Plummer et al., 2017 ) , and Visual Genome ( Krishna et al., 2017 ) , alongside an evolution of model development: from early methods based on alignment ( Karpathy and Fei-Fei, 2017 ; Rohrbach et al., 2016 ) to transformer architectures like MDETR ( Kamath et al., 2021 ) , GLIP ( Li et al., 2022 ) , and GroundingDINO ( Liu et al., 2024 ) that achieve strong performance on the grounding task. Additionally, several studies have also explored extensions of visual grounding to more complex settings, such as including pronouns in addition to noun phrases ( Lu et al., 2022 ) and grounding in contexts of human-robot interaction ( Mi et al., 2020 ) . Despite these advances, most existing benchmarks still lack a well-defined categorization of ambiguity and real-world conversations for human-robot interaction.
blocks.zh: 视觉地基定位是一项根本的任务,它把表达方式与视觉世界中的区域联系起来. 文献包括了FRCCO及其变体等基础基准(Mao等,2016;Kazemzadeh等,2014;Yu等,2016;Flickr30k实体(Plummer等,2017;Visual Genome等,2017;Krishna等,2017),以及模型发展的演变:从基于对接的早期方法(Karepathy and Fei-Fei,2017;Rohrbach等,2016)到MDETR(Kamath等,2021;GLIP等,2022;GroundingDINO(Liui等,2024))等在地平面任务上取得强效的变相. 此外,一些研究还探索了将视觉地基扩展至更复杂的环境,例如除了名词短语(Lu等,2022年)之外,还包括代名词,以及在人与机器人互动的背景下地基(Mi等,2020年)。 尽管取得了这些进展,但大多数现有基准仍然缺乏关于人与机器人互动的模糊性和现实世界对话的明确分类。

blocks.en: Ambiguity is widely recognized as a fundamental challenge in multimodal understanding. Prior work has primarily studied this phenomenon in tasks such as visual question answering (VQA) ( Inadumi et al., 2024 ; Testoni et al., 2025 ; Jian et al., 2025 ; Jang and Kim, 2026 ) , as well as multimodal machine translation ( Ma et al., 2024 ) . In human-robot interaction, systems are required not only to answer questions but also to localize and use intended objects in the visual scene. While these studies partially address such challenges, they do not sufficiently explore ambiguity that can arise from visual similarity or linguistic underspecification in dialogue contexts.
blocks.zh: 模糊性被广泛认为是多式联运理解中的一个根本挑战。 先前的工作主要在视觉问答(VQA)(Inadumi等,2024;Testoni等,2025;Jian等,2025;Jang和Kim,2026)等任务中研究了这一现象,以及多模式机器翻译(Ma等,2024. 在人与机器人的相互作用中,系统不仅需要回答问题,还需要在视觉场景中定位和使用预定对象. 虽然这些研究部分解决了这些挑战,但它们没有充分探讨对话中视觉相似性或语言特征不足可能引起的模糊性。

blocks.en: Integrating dialogue as additional context for visual grounding has also been explored. Benchmarks like SIMMC 2.0 ( Kottur et al., 2021 ) , GuessWhat?! ( Tu et al., 2021 ) and InViG ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) contain dialogues with disambiguation questions, allowing model evaluation under open-ended ambiguous queries. As a challenging setting, the J-CRe3 dataset ( Ueda et al., 2024 ) provides visual grounding in Japanese dialogue as one of its tasks, offering insight into visual grounding under multimodal ambiguity. Our benchmark extends J-CRe3 and investigates more practical ambiguities that depend on the context of human-robot interaction.
blocks.zh: 此外,还探讨了将对话作为视觉定位的额外背景。 SIMMC 2.0等基准(Kottur等人,2021年),猜猜 你说什么? (Tu等,2021年)和InViG(Zhang等,2024年)包含有分解问题的对话,允许在开放式的模糊询问下进行模型评价. 作为一种具有挑战性的设置,J-CRe3数据集(上田等,2024年)在日本对话中提供视觉地基作为它的任务之一,为在多模式模糊下进行视觉地基提供洞察. 我们的基准扩展了J-CRe3,并调查了更实际的模糊之处,这些模糊之处取决于人与机器人互动的背景.

blocks.en: 3.2 Ambiguity Categorization
blocks.zh: 3.2 模糊分类

blocks.en: In our work, we assume two types of ambiguity that can occur in multimodal inputs to conversational systems. These ambiguity categories are used to balance the data during dataset construction and are also used in the subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 在我们的工作中,我们假定在对对话系统的多模式投入中可能出现两种模糊性。 这些模棱两可的类别用于在数据集构建过程中平衡数据,并被后期分析所使用.

blocks.en: The instruction u u is linguistically explicit, but multiple objects in image I I match the description. We distinguish two types of visual ambiguity: • Same Object: multiple instances of the same object candidate, for instance, “pass me the mug ” ( “ マグカップ を取って” ) where there is more than one mug in the image. • Same Attribute: multiple objects share the specified attribute(s), such as “pass me the white object” ( “ 白い 物体を取って” ) where there is more than one white candidate in the visual input.

blocks.en: Same Object: multiple instances of the same object candidate, for instance, “pass me the mug ” ( “ マグカップ を取って” ) where there is more than one mug in the image.
blocks.zh: 相同对象:同一对象候选人的多个例子,例如“给我杯子”(“QQQ”),图像中有一个以上的杯子。

blocks.en: Same Attribute: multiple objects share the specified attribute(s), such as “pass me the white object” ( “ 白い 物体を取って” ) where there is more than one white candidate in the visual input.
blocks.zh: 相同的属性:多个对象共享指定的属性,例如,在视觉输入中有一个以上的白色候选对象的"通过我白色对象"("QQ").

blocks.en: The instruction u u is underspecified at the discourse level, as it lacks sufficient contextual information to identify the target object in the image I I uniquely. Zero anaphora is very common in Japanese language and requires the dialogue history H H to be resolved.

blocks.en: 4 JAG-D Overview
blocks.zh: 4 JAG-D概览

Dialogue modes are assigned as follows: resolving for ambiguous instructions, supportive for unambiguous instructions, and non-resolving for both.

blocks.en: We present JAG-D, a Japanese benchmark for evaluating visual grounding under controlled multimodal ambiguity in conversational settings. The dataset isolates ambiguity categories and explicitly measures both ambiguity recognition and dialogue-based resolution. We focus on Japanese because zero anaphora is frequently used in the language, making it natural for linguistic ambiguity to arise in ways that strongly depend on dialogue context ( Ono and Thompson, 1997 ; Seki et al., 2002 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们提出JAG-D,这是日本评估在对话环境中受控多式联运模糊度下的视觉地基的基准。 数据集将模棱两可的类别隔离开来,并明确衡量模棱两可的识别和基于对话的解析. 我们侧重于日语,因为语言中经常使用零安非他明,因此语言模糊性自然会以强烈依赖对话环境的方式出现(Ono and Thompson,1997;Seki等人,2002年)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Source Images
blocks.zh: 4.1 源图像

blocks.en: The images in the test set are sampled from J-CRe3 ( Ueda et al., 2024 ) , an egocentric human-robot interaction dataset collected in real-world environments (e.g., kitchens, offices, living rooms). We construct 480 instances starting from J-CRe3 visual content, prioritizing scenes with sufficient object density and diversity to enable controlled ambiguity under different environment combinations.
blocks.zh: 测试集中的图像取自J-CRe3(Ueda等,2024年),这是在现实世界环境中(如厨房,办公室,起居室)所收集的以自我为中心的人-机器人交互数据集. 我们从J-CRe3视觉内容开始构建出480个实例,以足够的物体密度和多样性优先排列场景,以便在不同的环境组合下实现可控模糊.

blocks.en: 4.2 Design Principles
blocks.zh: 4.2 设计原则

blocks.en: Each instance contains a single ground-truth bounding box b ∗ b^{*} . Ambiguity is introduced by ensuring that multiple regions satisfy the semantic constraints of instruction u u , while only one corresponds to the intended referent.
blocks.zh: 每个实例都包含一个单一的地上事实框b * b^{*}. 通过确保多个区域满足教学u u 的语义限制,而只有一个区域与预期的参考者相对应,从而引入了模糊性。

blocks.en: Ambiguous instructions are categorized into four types, described in Section 3.2 : same_object , same_attribute , pronoun_ambiguity , and zero_anaphora . This categorization enables fine-grained evaluation across distinct variants of ambiguity.
blocks.zh: 含糊的指令分为四种类型,在第3.2节中描述:同对象(object),同属性(object),代名词(noun_ombiguity)和零(anaphora). 这种分类使得能够对模糊性的不同变体进行细微的评价。

blocks.en:
Each instance consists of an instruction u u and dialogue history H H under three modes:
(i) resolving , where H H disambiguates u u ,
(ii) non-resolving , where ambiguity persists due to irrelevant context,
(iii) supportive , where H H provides redundant but consistent information for an unambiguous u u .
Examples are provided in Appendix A.2 .

每个实例包括一个u u 和对话历史 H 三种模式:
(一) 解决Hdambiguates u u u,
(二) 未解决,由于背景不相关,模糊不清,

blocks.en: 4.3 Data Generation and Validation
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据生成和验证

blocks.en: For each image, we generate an ambiguous or unambiguous instruction paired with dialogue history consistent with the designated ambiguity type and dialogue mode. The data generation pipeline is described in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个图像,我们生成一个模棱两可或毫不含糊的指令,与与指定的模棱两可类型和对话模式相匹配的对话历史。 数据生成管道的说明见附录A.3。

blocks.en: All instances are manually reviewed and corrected by two native Japanese annotators, with more than eight years of experience, ensuring that (i) the ambiguity matches the assigned category, (ii) the dialogue mode functions as intended, and (iii) the target bounding box aligns with the instruction.
blocks.zh: 所有情况均由两位日本本土的注解员进行人工审查和纠正,经验已超过8年,确保(一) 模糊度与指定类别相匹配,(二) 对话模式功能如所愿,(三) 目标边框与指令一致.

blocks.en: The final benchmark comprises 480 instances with balanced ambiguous and unambiguous conditions and controlled distributions across ambiguity types and dialogue settings (Table 1 ). JAG-D provides a carefully curated, human-evaluated test set of high-quality real-world disambiguation dialogues.
blocks.zh: 最终基准包括480个实例,有平衡的模糊和明确的条件,在模糊类型和对话环境之间有控制的分配(表1)。 JAG-D提供了一套精心设计的、经过人评价的高质量现实世界解析对话。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: 5.1 Multimodal Ambiguity Recognition
blocks.zh: 5.1 多式联运模糊性确认

blocks.en: We evaluate Japanese and multilingual VLMs on the multimodal ambiguity recognition task, using our benchmark. Specifically, we provide the models with two inputs: an image and an instruction, where the instruction is either ambiguous or unambiguous according to our ambiguity categorization.
blocks.zh: 我们利用我们的基准,评估日本语和多语种的自愿多数语对多式联运模糊性的认识任务。 具体地说,我们向模型提供了两种投入:一种是图像,一种是指示,根据我们的模棱两可分类,指示要么模棱两可,要么毫不含糊。

(2025) , and two multilingual VLMs, i.e., Qwen3-VL 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025) and Gemma3 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-3-12b-it Gemma Team (2025) . They were prompted under different settings (zero-shot and few-shot) and in both Japanese and English for the multilingual models (the prompts are provided in Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Visual Grounding Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.2 视觉地基评价

blocks.en: We evaluate models on ambiguous visual grounding settings with dialogue history integration as disambiguation context. Our evaluation includes the Japanese versions of two widely used grounding models, GLIP and MDETR, trained on both English datasets Krishna et al. (2017) ; Hudson and Manning (2019) and Japanese datasets ( Nakayama et al., 2020 ; Ueda et al., 2024 ) . We also evaluate Qwen3-VL, which has demonstrated strong multilingual performance and visual grounding capabilities ( Bai et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于模糊的视觉定位环境的模型,将对话历史的融合作为混淆不清的背景。 我们的评价包括两个被广泛使用的地基模型GLIP和MDETR的日文版本,这两个模型都接受了英语数据集Krishna等人(2017年);哈德逊和曼宁(2019年)和日本数据集(中山等,2020年;上田等,2024年)的培训. 我们还评价了Qune3-VL,它表现出了强大的多语言性能和视觉地面能力(Bai等,2025年)。

blocks.en: The evaluation pipeline comprises a two-phase evaluation protocol, designed to isolate grounding performance from raw user instruction (first phase) and the benefit of additional dialogue context to solve ambiguous scenarios (second phase). From the ones mentioned, Qwen is the only model that can handle long input, such as a complete dialogue history, while standard visual grounding models usually process short sentences or a list of phrases only. Consequently, we leverage an established method in the literature, by Willemsen et al. (2023) , to integrate the dialogue information into a single simple input sentence for the second-phase grounding task for GLIP and MDETR. This integration method consists of using an LLM (GPT-5.2 7 7 7 gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 in our case) to retrieve the important information from a dialogue and condense it into a shorter textual input. Both the Qwen’s prompt and the one used for the dialogue integration can be found in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 评价程序包括一个分两个阶段的评价协议,其目的是将业绩与原始用户指示分开(第一阶段),并受益于其他对话背景,以解决模棱两可的情况(第二阶段)。 从提到的那些模式来看,Quen是唯一能够处理长输入的模型,例如完整的对话历史,而标准视觉地基模型通常只处理短句或单词组列表. 因此,我们利用由Willemsen等人(2023年)撰写的文献中的一种既定方法,将对话信息纳入一个单一的简单输入句子,用于GLIP和MDETR的第二阶段基础任务。 这种整合方法包括使用LLM(GPT-5.2 7 7 gpt-5.2-2025-12-11 in our case)从对话中取出重要信息并收缩为更短的文字输入. Quen的提示和用于对话整合的提示都载于附录C。

blocks.en: 5.3 Dialogue Intervention Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 对话干预分析

blocks.en: We study which properties of the dialogue history support grounding through controlled input interventions on Qwen3-VL. Keeping the image and final ambiguous instruction fixed, we replace the Phase-2 dialogue with counterfactual variants.
blocks.zh: 我们研究对话历史的哪些特性通过对Qune3-VL的有控制的输入干预来支持其基础。 保持图像和最后的模棱两可的指令固定下来,我们用反事实变体取代了Phase-2对话.

blocks.en: We define twelve interventions across four dimensions. Reference conditions include the original Phase-2 input (“Full dialogue”) and the Phase-1 instruction (human order) without dialogue (“Order only”). Order perturbations preserve turns while disrupting sequence through random shuffling over five seeds (“Shuffle turns”) or full reversal (“Reverse order”). Content perturbations separate informativeness from token count using irrelevant in-domain dialogue (“Irrelevant substitution”), semantically neutral acknowledgements (“Neutral substitution”), or augmented histories in which irrelevant filler is added at the end (“Irrelevant suffix”) or between turns (“Irrelevant interleaving”). Selective exposure retains only subsets of the dialogue: the first or last k = 2 k{=}2 turns (“First K K turns”, “Last K K turns”) or speaker-specific transcripts (“Robot only”, “Human only”).
blocks.zh: 我们确定了涉及四个方面的12个干预措施。 参考条件包括原第2阶段输入(“完全对话”)和没有对话的第1阶段指示(人类秩序)(“只有命令”)。 顺序扰动保留了转弯,同时通过在5个种子上随机地打乱顺序(“轮回”)或完全倒转(“倒转顺序”)。 内容扰动使用不相关的域内对话(“不相关的替换”)、内容中立的确认(“Neutral替换”)或增加在结尾处(“不相关的后缀”)或在转弯之间(“不相关的互通”)添加不相关的填充器的历史,将信息与符号计数分开。 选择性接触只保留对话的子集:第一个或最后一个k = 2 k{=}2个转弯(“第一个K K转弯”、“最后一个K K转弯”)或针对发言者的笔录(“只有机器人,“只有人类”)。

blocks.en: We report the following metrics: mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), Acc@ 0.5 0.5 , and Δ \Delta mIoU relative to “full dialogue” performance.
blocks.zh: 我们报告以下衡量标准:关于“全面对话”的“联盟”的“交叉”、Acc@0.5和\Delta mIoU。

blocks.en: 6 Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en: We organise our analysis around three research questions: RQ1: Can current VLMs recognize multimodal ambiguity, and does the difficulty vary between visual and linguistic categories? RQ2: Does dialogue history improve visual grounding under ambiguity, and to what extent does the benefit differ across ambiguity types? RQ3: Does dialogue content contribute to visual grounding under ambiguity beyond surface properties such as length and format?
blocks.zh: 我们围绕三个研究问题组织我们的分析: RQ1:当前VLM能否识别多模式模糊,视觉和语言类别之间的难度是否不同? RQ2:对话历史是否在模糊不清的情况下改进了视觉基础,在模糊不清的类别中,好处有多大不同? RQ3:对话内容是否有助于视觉在长度和格式等表面属性以外的模糊度下站起?

blocks.en: Our experiments reveal a consistent asymmetry across both tasks: VLMs handle linguistic ambiguity substantially better than visual ambiguity. Additionally, dialogue provides the largest grounding gains precisely where it can supply the missing linguistic referent for pronoun and zero anaphora, leaving visual ambiguity as a persistent bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验显示,在两项任务中,始终存在不对称现象: VLMs处理语言上的模糊性比视觉上的模糊性要好得多. 此外,对话提供了最大的基础成果,即它能够提供缺失的代名词和去甲磷的语法参考,使视觉模糊成为持久的瓶颈。

blocks.en: RQ1: Multimodal Ambiguity Recognition
blocks.zh: RQ1:多式联运模糊性确认

blocks.en: Table 2 reports macro-F1 and per-category recall for all models. Multilingual VLMs clearly outperform their Japanese-specific counterparts: Qwen3-VL and Gemma3 reach the highest overall scores (83.0 and 78.5 F1-M, respectively), whereas the best Japanese model, LLM-jp VILA, achieves 60.1. The remaining Japanese models, Sarashina2 (40.3) and EvoVLM-JP (32.6), perform below the chance prediction level, underscoring a wide capability gap between model families on multimodal ambiguity recognition.
blocks.zh: 表2报告所有模型的宏观-F1和每个类别召回情况。 多种语言的VLM明显超越了日本特有的对应器:Qune3-VL和Gemma3达到最高的总分(分别为83.0和78.5 F1-M),而日本最好的模式LLM-jp VILA则能达到60.1. 其余的日本模型Sarashina2(40.3)和EvoVLM-JP(32.6)的成绩低于机会预测水平,突出了模型家族之间在多式联运模糊识别方面存在的巨大能力差距.

blocks.en: The per-category breakdown exposes a sharp split. Multilingual VLMs (Qwen3-VL and Gemma3) achieve near-ceiling recall on linguistic ambiguity: 96.7–100.0 on pronoun and 93.1–100.0 on zero_anaphora . In contrast, performance collapses on visual categories, with same_object recall, for instance, dropping to 32.8 and 39.7 for these same models. This asymmetry directly answers RQ1 : VLMs are strong at detecting underspecification in the text (pronouns, missing arguments) but largely fail to detect that multiple regions in the image satisfy the instruction constraints, where multimodal reasoning is actually required.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We present a systematic analysis of ambiguity in visual grounding through JAG-D, a new Japanese test set that evaluates visual and linguistic ambiguity in human-robot interaction scenarios, providing dialogue as a disambiguation context. Across both ambiguity recognition and grounding, we observe a consistent asymmetry: Japanese and multilingual VLMs resolve discourse-driven (linguistic) ambiguity substantially better than scene-driven (visual) ambiguity. We show that current VLMs can recognize linguistic ambiguity with high confidence (93.1-100.0 recall), while performing poorly on visual ambiguity (32.8-54.5 recall). For visual grounding, dialogue context substantially improves performance for linguistic cases (up to + 60.3 +60.3 Acc@0.5 for zero-anaphora), whereas visual ambiguity remains a persistent bottleneck, with 25.9 accuracy in the worst case even after dialogue enhancement. Overall, our findings identify visual ambiguity as a central unresolved challenge for robust conversational grounding and motivate models capable of reasoning over multiple modalities beyond surface-level linguistic pattern matching.
blocks.zh: 我们通过JAG-D对视觉地面上的模糊性进行了系统分析,这是一套新的日本测试,用来评价人-机器人相互作用情景中的视觉和语言模糊性,将对话作为模糊不清的背景。 从模糊的认知和地基上来看,我们观察到始终存在的不对称现象: 日语和多语种的VLM解决了由话语驱动(语言)的模糊性大大好于由场景驱动(视觉)的模糊性. 我们显示,目前的VLM可以高度自信地识别语言上的模糊性(93.1-100.00回想),同时在视觉上的模糊性(32.8-54.5回想)表现不佳. 就视觉定位而言,对话背景大大改善了语言案例的性能(0-anaphora可达+60.3+60.3 Acc@0.5),而视觉模糊仍是一个持续存在的瓶颈,即使在加强对话之后,最糟糕的情况是25.9的准确性。 总体而言,我们的调查结果认为,视觉模糊是无法解决的一项核心挑战,对稳健的谈话基础,并激励能够对表层语言模式匹配以外的多种模式进行推理的模型。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: First, our benchmark size is relatively small compared to standard grounding datasets. However, it is explicitly designed as a highly curated diagnostic test set requiring specific real-world objects and precise multi-turn dialogue. We prioritized linguistic fidelity via native Japanese annotator validation to ensure the accurate representation of complex and context-dependent phenomena like zero anaphora. Second, our findings are currently limited to Japanese; future work must explore whether this visual-linguistic asymmetry persists in a range of distinct languages. Finally, our dialogue-enhanced evaluation for GLIP and MDETR relies on an LLM-based (GPT-5.2) text integration pipeline. This was necessitated by the current lack of Japanese-specific visual grounding models capable of natively processing long-context dialogue histories. Consequently, reported gains for these architectures reflect the pipeline’s effectiveness rather than the grounding models’ intrinsic multi-turn capabilities.
blocks.zh: 首先,与标准地基数据集相比,我们的基准规模相对较小。 然而,它被明确设计为一套高度精密的诊断测试集,需要特定的现实世界对象和精确的多回合对话. 我们把语言忠诚放在优先位置,通过日本本土的注释者验证,确保准确反映复杂和依赖背景的现象,如 " 零安非他明 " 。 第二,我们的调查结果目前仅限于日语;今后的工作必须探讨这种视觉语言不对称的现象是否在一系列不同的语言中持续存在. 最后,我们对GLIP和MDETR的对话强化评价依赖于基于LLM(GPT-5.2)的文本集成管道。 之所以需要这样做,是因为目前缺乏能够本土处理长文对话历史的日本特有的视觉地基模型。 因此,所报告的这些结构的收益反映了管道的有效性,而不是地面模型固有的多变能力。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our test set utilizes real-world human-robot interaction images from the J-CRe3 dataset Ueda et al. (2024) . In building upon this dataset, we ensured that our newly generated multi-turn dialogues and annotations did not introduce any sensitive or personally identifiable information regarding the actors in the visual sources. Furthermore, all manual dataset validation was conducted by native Japanese annotators who were compensated according to the task. Lastly, deploying multimodal models in physical robotic systems carries inherent safety risks if ambiguous commands are misinterpreted. By exposing current VLM failure modes regarding perceptual ambiguity, we aim to encourage the development of safer agents that actively seek clarification rather than executing potentially harmful actions based on underspecified instructions.
blocks.zh: 我们的测试集利用了J-CRe3数据集Ueda等人(2024年)的真人-机器人交互图像。 在这个数据集的基础上,我们确保我们新产生的多回合对话和说明不会引入任何关于视觉来源行为者的敏感或可识别的个人信息。 此外,所有人工数据集验证均由日本本土的注释员进行,他们根据任务得到补偿。 最后,如果含糊不清的命令被误解,在物理机器人系统中部署多式模型具有固有的安全风险。 通过揭露目前关于概念模糊的VLM故障模式,我们旨在鼓励发展安全剂,积极寻求澄清,而不是根据未明确的指示采取可能有害的行动。

blocks.en: Appendix C Visual Grounding Experiment
blocks.zh: 附录C 视觉地面实验

blocks.en: The visual grounding experiment compares two grounding models (GLIP and MDETR) and Qwen3-VL as a multilingual VLM. The models are tested in two different phases: 1. Instruction-only: the models receive as input only the human instruction, which can be ambiguous or not. 2. Dialogue-enhanced: in addition to the previous setting, the models receive a dialogue history as additional context, to potentially disambiguate the human instruction.
blocks.zh: 视觉地平面实验比较了两种地平面模型(GLIP和MDETR)和Qune3-VL作为多语言VLM. 这些模型分两个不同阶段进行测试: 1. 仅限指令:模型仅作为输入接收人类指令,而这种指令可能含糊不清或不明确。 2. 对话得到加强:除了以前的设定外,这些模式还得到了对话历史,作为额外的背景,从而可能使人类教导脱节。

blocks.en: Instruction-only: the models receive as input only the human instruction, which can be ambiguous or not.
blocks.zh: 仅限指令:模型仅作为输入接收人类指令,可能含糊不清或不明确.

blocks.en: Dialogue-enhanced: in addition to the previous setting, the models receive a dialogue history as additional context, to potentially disambiguate the human instruction.
blocks.zh: 对话增强:除了前作的设定外,模型还接收了对话历史作为额外的上下文,从而可能使人类教导脱节.

blocks.en: GLIP and MDETR can’t handle long context, such as the dialogue history. For this reason, we use a method from Willemsen et al. (2023) to integrate the dialogue information into a single instruction (Figure 8 ).
blocks.zh: GLIP 和 MDETR 无法处理长的背景, 如对话框历史 。 为此,我们使用从Willemsen等人(2023年)获得的方法,将对话信息整合到单一指令(图8.)中.

blocks.en: In contrast, Qwen3-VL handles long context, and we can pass it the dialogue history directly. Figure 9 and Figure 10 contains the instruction-only and the dialogue-enhanced prompts for Qwen, respectively.

blocks.zh: 附录D 对话干预实验

blocks.en:
To understand how the dialogue history impacts visual grounding in Qwen3-VL, we run controlled counterfactual interventions on the dialogue-enhanced grounding evaluation phase.
The interventions are the following:
blocks.zh:
为了了解对话历史如何影响在Qune3-VL的视觉地基,我们在对话加强地基评价阶段进行了有控制的反事实干预。
发言如下:

blocks.en: • Full dialogue: the original, unaltered dialogue history (Phase 2 baseline). • Order only: the human instruction only, with no dialogue (Phase 1 baseline). • Shuffled turns: the same dialogue turns in a random order. • Reversed turns: the dialogue with its turn order reversed. • Irrelevant filler: an unrelated dialogue, length-matched to the original to control for token volume. • Last K K turns: only the final K K turns of the dialogue ( K = 2 K{=}2 ). • First K K turns: only the initial K K turns of the dialogue ( K = 2 K{=}2 ). • Neutral substitution: the dialogue is replaced with generic robot/human turns matched to the original length. • Irrelevant suffix: the true dialogue followed by irrelevant turns. • Irrelevant interleaving: the original dialogue with one irrelevant line inserted after each original turn. • Robot turns only: the dialogue restricted to robot utterances. • Human turns only: the dialogue restricted to human utterances.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 完全对话:原始的,不变的对话历史(第二阶段基线). • 只有命令:只有人的指示,没有对话(第一阶段基线)。 • 摇摆转向:同一对话框按随机顺序转动。 二. 支助 倒转:对话的倒转顺序倒转. • 不相干填充器:不相干的对话,长度与原件相匹配,以控制符号量。 上个 K K 转弯: 只有对话的最后 K K K 转弯( K = 2 K{=}2 ) 。 ^ 第一个 K K 转弯: 只有对话的初始 K K K 转弯( K = 2 K{=}2 ) 。 ^ 中性替换: 对话被通用机器人/人类转弯所取代,与原长度相匹配 。 • 不相干后缀:真正的对话,然后是无关紧要的转弯。 • 互不相干:原来的对话,每回互不相干。 机器人只转身:仅限机器人发声的对话. • 仅限人发言:对话仅限于人的发言。
